claims.claim: You need evidence of your caring role to claim Carer's Allowance.
claims.note: The page says you must care for at least 35 hours a week, but its list of what to have before you apply does not ask for any evidence of the caring role.

claims.claim: You need a benefit award letter for the person you care for.
claims.quote: The person you care for must already get one of these benefits
claims.note: The page says the person must already get a qualifying benefit and asks for their details (and a DLA reference if they are under 16), but it does not mention an award letter.
